# Version 4.159.0 (Unreleased)
> **Image testing and rendering reliability**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.159.0 adds experimental image comparison APIs and fixes runtime-effect initialization and Windows image-decoding crashes. A separate SkiaSharp.Testing package supports tolerance-based image comparisons and visual diagnostics. GPU texture-edge sampling also changes, while Linux x86 native assets are removed.

## Breaking Changes

- **Move Linux x86 deployments to a supported architecture** — Linux x86 native assets are no longer built or included in NuGet packages. Move applications deploying to linux-x86 to a supported Linux architecture before upgrading. ([#5784](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5784))

## API Surface

- **Experimental image comparison package** — SkiaSharp.Testing compares SKImage, SKBitmap and SKPixmap inputs with channel tolerances, masks, mismatch budgets and error metrics, and creates caller-owned difference images. The assembly is experimental; opt in by suppressing diagnostic SKIA4001 with NoWarn or a pragma. ([#5293](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5293))

## Bug Fixes

- **Windows x64 decoder recovery no longer terminates the process** — Fixes crashes when libjpeg or libpng uses longjmp for error recovery in clang-built Windows x64 natives, including malformed JPEGs passed to SKCodec.Create and PDF output using lazily decoded non-JPEG images. Other Windows architectures and MSVC builds are unchanged. — ❤️ [@SimonCropp](https://github.com/SimonCropp) ([#5827](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5827))
- **Uniform buffers start and reset to zero** — SKRuntimeEffectUniforms no longer exposes uninitialized values on creation or after Reset(). Reset clears the existing buffer in place instead of allocating a new native block and managed wrapper, including when uniforms are reused for meshes. — ❤️ [@taublast](https://github.com/taublast) ([#5843](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5843))
- **Filtered GPU sampling stays inside texture subsets** — Ganesh sampling uses an inward inset to avoid including undefined texels beyond subset edges. Texture-edge pixels may change; this is not a CPU or Graphite rendering change. ([#5679](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5679))
- **Tizen CPU blur selection takes effect** — Tizen now applies its intended blur configuration to Skia itself, selecting the existing ThreeBoxApprox/Tent paths instead of the shader-based Gaussian candidate. Blur pixels and performance may differ; Tizen rendering and performance were not measured in the source change. ([#5679](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5679))
